_comment: One object per product. status: 'draft' renders a DRAFT watermark/badge and keeps buying disabled. Set status 'approved', replace images, and fill pod_url (Printful/Printify/Shopify/Etsy product link) to enable the Buy button. target_price/edition_size are proposals, not live data.

products.title: Kept The Car
products.blurb: The settlement was brutal. The 0DTE strategy was worse. But the convertible? The convertible is still yours, drifting past Mars with the top down and no destination.

products.title: Exploded On The Pad
products.blurb: T-minus zero. Full send on far-OTM calls with retirement money. A vintage launch-pad fireball for everyone whose long-term plan didn't survive the first candle.

products.title: Diamond Hands. No Pulse.
products.blurb: Never sold. Never stopped out. Never breathed again. A cracked-helmet skull with a death grip on the wheel, for the bagholder who took 'hold forever' literally.

products.title: Every Rocket Lands
products.blurb: Gravity always wins. So does theta. For anyone who watched their calls go to the moon in the premarket and expire worthless by 4:00.
